name: async-agents-box-widget
description: Renders pi-subagents' async-agents above-editor panel as a bordered box (beads-box-widget / pi-goal-x house style) by wrapping the component at pi's widget-API boundary. No upstream code is touched and no run state is re-derived: the framed lines ARE pi-subagents' own output, so spinners, folding and live updates keep working. Required because pi-subagents has no config knob to restyle the widget (asyncWidget only hides it).
